reuse.why: Routes the preview, posting and action-sync copies through the existing getScheduledAmount helper; schedule-template and forecast call the new range helper but keep their own number/range dispatch instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

duplication.why: Removes four inline midpoint copies; two small typeof/op dispatches remain at schedule-template and forecast-schedules that getScheduledAmount already covers.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to getScheduledAmount, where the tree keeps schedule amount logic.

scope.why: Only the ranged-amount sites, a comment, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: One named function defines the worst-case rule and every path uses it; the two leftover local dispatches are a small wart.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts createScheduleList and forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule dispatch op/typeof themselves and call getRangedScheduleAmount instead of getScheduledAmount

disguised_duplication.where: The midpoint copies were removed and replaced by calls to the shared helpers, not reshaped.

one_place.where: getRangedScheduleAmount in shared/schedules.ts, used by getScheduledAmount and directly by schedule-template.ts and forecast-schedules.ts; all six former midpoint sites now go through it.
